2026_02_MIN_CHI.headline: Wentz steps into Minnesota’s blitz chess match with Chicago
2026_02_MIN_CHI.paragraph1: Minnesota will start Carson Wentz while Kyler Murray remains out, and the Vikings also enter without Jauan Jennings, increasing the burden on their protection and run game. Chicago’s offense erupted in Week 1, but now faces Brian Flores’ aggressive pressure structure after Minnesota blitzed Green Bay relentlessly. Caleb Williams’ response to simulated pressure and late rotation is central, while Wentz must avoid giving Chicago short fields if the Vikings cannot consistently create explosive plays.
2026_02_MIN_CHI.model_rationale: Chicago can control the matchup if Williams handles Minnesota’s pressure cleanly, while the Vikings need Wentz to protect possession and create enough explosives to prevent a one-sided script.
